The class has integral r=0, abs(r)<=rho/2, psi in H1_0 and eta in H1_0 with supremum norm<=1/4. No gradient supremum cap is imposed. Explicit gates alpha=3C rho_max ell integral1/A/(2cs squared)<=k/4 and beta=ell squared supR/J<=1/4 hold after shortening, with R=qhat squared/(2kA)+Dhat/2 and qhat,Dhat the bounded finite-scale background suprema. The proof derives a global signed scalar inequality with constant1/64 and retains the exact matter/scale couplings. This is a strict restricted static energetic minimum, not a dynamical stability result.
